'''Valentin Afanasyevich Koptyug''' ({{langx|ru|Валентин Афанасьевич Коптюг}}; June 9, 1931 – January 10, 1997) was a Soviet Belarusian scientist, specializing in physical and organic chemistry.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://sbras.nsu.ru/?int=VIEW&el=3352&templ=VIEW |title=Valentin Koptyug in the history of Siberian Division of the Russian Academy of Sciences (SD RAS) |access-date=2015-03-19 |archive-date=2015-04-02 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402111954/http://sbras.nsu.ru/?int=VIEW&el=3352&templ=VIEW |url-status=dead }}</ref>

== Biography ==
Valentin Koptyug was born in 1931 in Yukhnov in the family of Afanasy Koptyug, who was director of the local communication department, and Nadezhda Koptyug, who was a telegrapher. When young Koptyug was studying in school, his family had to evacuate because of [[Eastern Front (World War II)|Great Patriotic War]]. In 1949 he finished school in [[Samarkand]] and graduated from [[D. Mendeleev University of Chemical Technology of Russia]] in 1954 in [[Moscow]]. In 1957, Koptyg completed postgraduate studies at this institution. He worked at the Mendeleev University from 1957 to 1959.<ref name="multiple">{{cite book |author=Ламин В. А. |url= |title=Энциклопедия. Новосибирск |publisher=Новосибирское книжное издательство |year=2003 |isbn=5-7620-0968-8 |edition= |volume= |location=Новосибирск |pages=444–445 |chapter= |format= |chapter-url= |agency= |orig-year=}}</ref>

In 1959 the scientist began his career at the [[Vorozhtsov Novosibirsk Institute of Organic Chemistry|Institute of Organic Chemistry]] in [[Novosibirsk]], where he was the head of the laboratory from 1959 to 1987, and then the director of this institute (1987–1997).<ref name="multiple" />

He was a chancellor of [[Novosibirsk State University]] for two years (1978&ndash;1980).<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.nsc.ru/en/ppls/vak/ |title=Valentin Koptyug in the English version of SD RAS site |access-date=2015-03-19 |archive-date=2015-03-10 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150310170211/http://www.nsc.ru/en/ppls/vak/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> Koptyug made a huge contribution in development of synthetic, physical and applied chemistry. Also, he founded some large scientific schools in the fields of organic chemistry and chemoinformatics.<ref>[http://museum.nsu.ru/?int=VIEW&el=362&templ=WINDOW_VIEW Koptyug as chancellor of NSU]</ref>

There are a monument and a [[Academician Koptyug Avenue, Novosibirsk|street]] named after Koptyug in [[Akademgorodok]], [[Novosibirsk]].<ref>[http://gold.vixpo.nsu.ru/default.aspx?db=museum_1959&int=VIEW&el=5274&templ=VIEW Monument of Valentin Koptyug]</ref> Also, there are several awards and grants of his name for students and scientists.

Valentin Koptyug was buried at the [[Yuzhnoye Cemetery (Novosibirsk)|Yuzhnoye Cemetery]] in Novosibirsk.
